introSection.title: AI Should Solve Problems. Not Just Sound Innovative.
introSection.lead: AI becomes valuable when it helps people do something better—whether that's finding the right product, understanding business data, automating repetitive work, or interacting with software more naturally.
paragraphs: At FuduGo, we build AI-powered solutions around specific business requirements. From generative AI and intelligent search to automation and voice AI, we focus on turning AI capabilities into practical tools that businesses can actually use.

aiDevelopment.title: How We Actually Build With AI
aiDevelopment.lead: We use AI-enabled development tools, including AI-powered coding agents, on every project we build, including this one. That's not a separate claim we make for this page; it's the same process behind every service we offer.

items.title: We Use What We Sell
items.description: Our own development workflow runs on Gemini-powered coding agents built into our editors, which means the AI features we build for you come from a team that uses AI daily, not one that reads about it.

items.title: Intent-Based Intelligence, Not Just Keyword Matching
items.description: Where it fits, we build AI that understands what a user actually wants, like a product search that surfaces jackets and sweaters for a "winter clothes" query, rather than returning nothing because "winter" isn't a product name.

items.title: Automation That Knows Its Limits
items.description: AI can draft a registration form, suggest a code block, or handle a routine voice query in minutes instead of hours, but our team decides where automation should hand off to a human, so your customers never get stuck talking to a system that can't help them.

items.title: Built-In Security From Day One
items.description: Every AI feature we build goes through the same AI-assisted security checks we use across all our development, catching potential gaps before launch rather than after.

items.question: What AI services does FuduGo provide?
items.answer: FuduGo provides AI development, Generative AI, AI automation, Voice AI agents, AI-powered search, and other AI-enabled functionality based on business requirements.

items.question: Can you add AI to an existing website or application?
items.answer: Yes. AI functionality can be integrated into existing websites, applications, e-commerce platforms, and business systems where it provides a practical benefit.

items.question: How can AI improve an e-commerce website?
items.answer: AI can improve product discovery through intent-based search, recommendations, and other intelligent functionality. For example, a search for "winter clothes" can surface relevant products even when "winter" isn't part of a product name.

items.question: Can AI analyze my business data?
items.answer: Yes. AI-powered business tools can be designed to analyze relevant business data and provide insights through natural-language queries, depending on the available data and system architecture.

items.question: What is an AI agent?
items.answer: An AI agent is a system designed to perform tasks or interact with information based on instructions and defined capabilities. The appropriate design depends on what the agent needs to accomplish.
